name: Fusion Desk
description:
All-in-one desktop panel: taskbar, start menu with 7 layouts, system monitor, clipboard history, media controls, clock, Caffeine timer and App Hub shortcuts.

Clipboard: the clipboard history reads the clipboard whenever its content changes and keeps the entries in memory and, unless you turn it off, in ~/.cache/fusion-desk/clipboard.json (entries marked secret by password managers are skipped). Super+V opens the history; it can be turned off in the settings. Paste-on-select (sends Ctrl+V to the focused window through a virtual keyboard) is opt-in. Clipboard data is never sent anywhere.

App Hub: when the App Hub app is installed, the menu shows app updates through its app-hub command; otherwise the button opens the App Hub download page.
